definition.simple: The invisible pull that brings two things together. It's why we stay on Earth and the moon stays in orbit.
definition.academic: The universal force of attraction acting between all matter.

examples: An apple falling from a tree.

common_misconceptions: Gravitation only acts on Earth (False, it acts everywhere in the universe).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student what would happen to the oceans without the moon's gravity.
